create_account.description: Create an Eloqua account (company) with a name. Returns the new account with its ID.
create_account.name: create_account

create_contact.description: Create an Eloqua contact with an email address and optional first and last name. Returns the new contact with its ID.
create_contact.name: create_contact

delete_account.description: Delete an account (company) from Eloqua, by its ID.
delete_account.name: delete_account

delete_contact.description: Delete a contact from Eloqua, by its ID.
delete_contact.name: delete_contact

get_account.description: Get one Eloqua account (company) by its ID, with its name and when it was created and last changed.
get_account.name: get_account

get_campaign.description: Get one Eloqua campaign by its ID, with its name and when it was created and last changed.
get_campaign.name: get_campaign

get_contact.description: Get one Eloqua contact by its ID, with their name, email address and when the record was created and last changed.
get_contact.name: get_contact

get_contact_list.description: Get one Eloqua shared contact list by its ID, with its name and when it was created and last changed.
get_contact_list.name: get_contact_list

get_email.name: get_email

get_form.description: Get one Eloqua form by its ID, with its name and when it was created and last changed.
get_form.name: get_form

get_landing_page.description: Get one Eloqua landing page by its ID, with its name and when it was created and last changed.
get_landing_page.name: get_landing_page

list_accounts.description: List Eloqua accounts (companies), a page at a time, with an optional search and level of detail. Returns each account's ID and name.
list_accounts.name: list_accounts

list_campaigns.description: List Eloqua campaigns, a page at a time, with an optional search and level of detail. Returns each campaign's ID and name.
list_campaigns.name: list_campaigns

list_contact_lists.description: List Eloqua shared contact lists, a page at a time, with an optional search and level of detail. Returns each list's ID and name.
list_contact_lists.name: list_contact_lists

list_contacts.description: List Eloqua contacts, a page at a time, with an optional search and level of detail. Returns each contact's ID, name and email address.

list_emails.description: List the marketing emails in Eloqua, a page at a time, with an optional search and level of detail. Returns each email's ID and name.
list_emails.name: list_emails

list_forms.description: List Eloqua forms, a page at a time, with an optional search and level of detail. Returns each form's ID and name.
list_forms.name: list_forms

list_landing_pages.description: List Eloqua landing pages, a page at a time, with an optional search and level of detail. Returns each page's ID and name.
list_landing_pages.name: list_landing_pages

update_account.description: Rename an Eloqua account (company), found by its ID. Returns the updated account.
update_account.name: update_account

update_contact.description: Change an Eloqua contact's email address, first name or last name, found by its ID. Returns the updated contact.
update_contact.name: update_contact

oracle_eloqua_new_account_trigger.description: Runs for each new account in Oracle Eloqua. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.
